rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=8, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=14, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (UNROLLED DEPTH, the last untested architectural axis): vn_T 5 -> 8. BASE = iter-1 BEST config (vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=200; NOT the regressed iter-2/3/4 and NOT iter-5 train_n=480). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS, all hr=0, ALL <= the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor, baseline_PSNR 34.08): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (N_k=16, lam=0.0023, vn_T=5, 1295.7s) <- prior BEST-structural; iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED -0.0133); iter-3 SSIM 0.768197 (vn_lambda_init 0.0023->0.05 DC^ REGRESSED -0.0238); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (vn_normalize_filters F->T REGRESSED -0.0346); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 PSNR 32.45 RMSE 1.192e-3 (train_n 200->480 data-coverage -> +0.0036 vs iter-1, but still <0.84, hr 0) <- run-BEST. LIMITER = REGULARISER-DEGRADATION, not under-training: loss flat by ep3 EVERY iter (vs the SIBLING hammernik_2017 which WAS under-trained -- epochs^ cleared ITS floor to hr 0.0375 at iter-7; hammernik_vn has NO such epoch headroom, loss is already converged). The learned VN regulariser term Sum_i K_i^T rho_prime_i(K_i u) acts as a BLUNT SMOOTHER dragging the FBP init below baseline. Capacity (filters), DC-weight (lambda), filter-constraint, AND data-coverage (train_n) are now ALL exhausted -- each either regressed or barely moved. The ONE architectural axis untouched across all 5 iters is the UNROLLED DEPTH vn_T (held =5 every iter). MECHANISM: each unrolled step t applies u <- u - K^T rho_prime - lam*R^T(Ru-g)/dc_norm, i.e. an in-loop PYRO-NN projector data-consistency step. More steps (T 5->8) means the true-projector DC term re-anchors the recon to the MEASURED sinogram 8 times instead of 5 -- the only mechanism in this architecture that can COUNTERACT the per-step regulariser smoothing (the DC pull, applied more often, fights the blunt-smoother regulariser). HYPOTHESIS: with vn_T 5->8 the extra projector-DC re-anchoring lifts val_ssim above the run-best 0.80886 toward the ~0.84 FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER (terminal): if val_ssim stays <= 0.81 (still <FBP, hr=0) even at deeper unrolling, hammernik_vn is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on rebinned 2304-view Mayo LDCT with ALL architectural axes exhausted (capacity, DC-weight, filter-constraint, data-coverage, AND depth) -> file the NEGATIVE RESULT and drive the remaining iters to DOCUMENT the ceiling toward iter-20, not chase it. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T 5->8 = 1.6x per-step DC+RBF cost. iter-1 ran ~7 ep/1000s at train_n=200,vn_T=5 (~143 s/ep) => at vn_T=8 ~229 s/ep => max_train_s=1000 trips at ~4.4 ep (>3, past the ep3 convergence point -> the converged comparison is fair). train_n REVERTED 480->200 (iter-5 coverage gain was a marginal +0.0036; at train_n=480+vn_T=8 the per-ep ~550s gives <2 ep -> would NOT converge). val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~165 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1165s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (~635s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=8 x N_k=16 but vn_checkpoint=true gradient-checkpoints each of the 8 unrolled steps (activation memory ~constant in T, NOT 8x) + batch_size=2 keep it within the 16 GB RTX5000 (cf. hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward, and a deeper unroll makes the clip MORE load-bearing).
